bagPolicy.summary: Each person can bring one small bag no larger than A4 size (297mm x 210mm x 210mm). Larger bags are refused entry.
allowed: One small bag per person up to 297mm high, 210mm wide and 210mm deep
Medical equipment with an approved Medical Exemption Certificate
prohibited: More than one bag per person
Bags folded over to reduce their size
bagPolicy.note: Medical equipment exceptions need permission in advance: contact the stadium before event day and request a Medical Exemption Certificate, then show it to security. Camera rules can change per event. The page does not mention a bag drop.

parking.note: Wembley Stadium is primarily a public transport destination with easy access via three railway stations. Visitors driving to the stadium should be aware of the Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) charges applicable to non-compliant vehicles.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Wembley Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Wembley Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options including hearty and healthy breakfast menus, buffet and bowl food menus, and a la carte dining. Special offerings include customizable day delegate packages and dinner packages with room hire and drinks. The venue also provides options for canape receptions and drinks receptions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Wembley Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Both East and West ticket offices are located on our Mezzanine Level also called B1 Level. Both East and West Ticket Offices are located on our Mezzanine Level (also known as B1 Level).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Wembley Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
